findings.pattern:
/
            ^(?:\/\/.*)                     # Lines that start with comments
        |
            (?:
                '(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*+'   # Strings enclosed in single quotes
            |
                "(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*+"      # Strings enclosed in double quotes
            )
        |
            (?:                            # Import statements (script captured)
                import\s*
                    (?:
                        (?:\*\s*as\s+\w+|\s+[\w\s{},*]+)
                        \s*from\s*
                    )?
            |
                export\s*
                    (?:\*(?:\s*as\s+\w+)?|\{[^}]*+\})
                    \s*from\s*
            |
                \bimport\(
            )
            \s*['"`](\.\/[^'"`\n]++|(\.\.\/)*+[^'"`\n]++)['"`]\s*[;\)]
        ?
    /mxu

issues.message:
An anchor holds for its own alternative only: "(?:
                '(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*+'   # Strings enclosed in single quotes
            |
                "(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*+"      # Strings enclosed in double quotes
            )" matches anywhere in the subject.
issues.hint:
If the anchors are meant for every alternative, group them: "^(?:(?:\/\/.*)|(?:
                '(?:[^'\\\n]|\\.)*+'   # Strings enclosed in single quotes
            |
                "(?:[^"\\\n]|\\.)*+"      # Strings enclosed in double quotes
            )|(?:                            # Import statements (script captured)
                import\s*
                    (?:
                        (?:\*\s*as\s+\w+|\s+[\w\s{},*]+)
                        \s*from\s*
                    )?
            |
                export\s*
                    (?:\*(?:\s*as\s+\w+)?|\{[^}]*+\})
                    \s*from\s*
            |
                \bimport\(
            )
            \s*['"`](\.\/[^'"`\n]++|(\.\.\/)*+[^'"`\n]++)['"`]\s*[;\)]
        ?)".
